name: pivot_point_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the previous session's R1 and S1 pivot levels are pre-loaded by thousands of retail platforms (Zerodha, Upstox) and institutional execution algorithms before each open. When NIFTY closes a 5-second bar above R1, every long-only algo with a pivot-based entry receives a simultaneous signal — the collective institutional and retail response creates a compressed burst of 15-25 spot points within the next 60-90 seconds. At 5-second resolution we enter at the exact R1 crossover bar rather than waiting for 1-minute bar confirmation, capturing the leading edge of this pile-on rather than chasing it. The opposite applies for S1 breaks: stop-losses triggered below S1 cascade selling within 30-60 seconds.

indicators.name: pivot_R1
indicators.purpose: Fixed daily reference level derived from the previous session's OHLC. No scaling — pivot levels are day-anchored time windows, not rolling lookbacks. The level is constant for the whole session and recomputed daily.

indicators.name: pivot_S1
indicators.purpose: Mirror of R1. When NIFTY breaks below S1 with VWAP also below, it signals value destruction below the prior session's support range.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day at 09:15
indicators.purpose: VWAP acts as the session's institutional average cost. A pivot break with close above VWAP confirms institutions are net buyers. This filters pivot breaks that occur below the institutional cost basis (more likely to fail).

indicators.name: vol_ma_60
indicators.purpose: 60-bar (5-min) volume baseline. Original used 20-bar on 1-min = 20 min; we compress to 5 min because at 5s resolution we want to detect current-session volume surges relative to recent activity, not hour-old baselines. Volume on 5s bars is noisy — 5-min baseline provides enough stability.

conditions: prev_close <= R1 AND close > R1 (R1 crossover on this bar)
buy_ce.confirmation: Single-bar crossover at 5s is sufficient — 2-bar confirmation from 1-min original is already satisfied by entering on the crossover bar itself at 5s resolution

conditions: prev_close >= S1 AND close < S1 (S1 crossover on this bar)

exit.stop_rationale: A failed R1 break on NIFTY typically stalls and reverses 8-12 spot points within 30 seconds; at delta ~0.5 that is 4-6 option points. 4 pts covers noise without letting a clear failure run — if the breakout reverses 8 NIFTY pts back through R1, the thesis is definitively wrong.
exit.target_rationale: First-leg continuation after an R1 break on NIFTY extends 15-25 spot points before stalling at R2 or consolidation; 7 option pts captures ~50% of that expected 14-pt lower bound, giving 1:1.75 R:R. Consistent with the orb_momentum gold-standard target of 8 pts for similar breakout continuation.

filters.vix_filter: none — pivot levels are structural and work across VIX regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; skip first 5 minutes to avoid pre-open noise before pivots are clean
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment required — only take R1 breaks above VWAP, S1 breaks below VWAP

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — pivot levels are universally known; edge depends entirely on VWAP + volume filter quality. If too many false breaks occur near R1 in choppy markets, win rate drops below 50%.

adaptation_notes: Original was NIFTY 200 equity stocks on 1-min bars with 2-bar confirmation and R2/S2 targets. Key changes: (1) universe narrowed to NIFTY index itself — pivot levels on indices are more respected because they reflect the full market's prior session; (2) hold time compressed from 20-60 min to 30-90s — we capture only the first burst, not the full R1→R2 extension; (3) 2-bar confirmation dropped because at 5s a single crossover bar IS the fast confirmation (2 bars at 1min = 120s; 1 bar at 5s = 5s, the crossover already provides directional information); (4) volume SMA compressed from 20×1min=20min to 60×5s=5min for responsiveness; (5) R2/S2 targets replaced with fixed 7 option-point targets since R1→R2 spread is typically 80-150 NIFTY pts, far too wide for a 90s hold.
weaknesses: On narrow-range days (prev_H - prev_L < 100 pts), R1 and S1 are close to open — high false break rate
Post-event sessions (budget, RBI policy): pivots are blown through on news, not microstructure — volume filter may not catch this
NIFTY is index, not a single stock — pivot levels aggregated across 50 stocks may be less 'clean' than individual stock pivots
Volume on 5s NIFTY bars is noisy; 1.5x threshold may fire too often in high-activity sessions

_source.original_stop: Pivot point P (if price drops back from R1 to P)
_source.original_target: R2 for longs, S2 for shorts (next pivot level)
